title: The algorithm as a new run is offered it, on half-precision brains

why.mechanics: As the new-simulation form offered them on 2026-10-02 (gol_config.NEW_RUN_DEFAULTS): a parent may gift tokens to a neighbour, and links that carried nothing over a whole iteration are cut at the end of reproduction. Everything else at its frozen default.
why.brain_kind: float16 rather than the form's float. Every run made by hand so far used it, and it halves what a brain costs in memory and on disk, which is what lets worlds of 100,000 tokens and more run several at a time. Whether three decimal digits of weight are enough is an experiment on the roadmap.
why.total_tokens: Only what a plan inherits if it says nothing. Every experiment chooses its own world size, for its question and its time.
why.k_neighbors: 0: max(n/100, 5) neighbours in the starting ring, which networkx wires as 4 when the number is odd.
why.hidden_layers: The preset for float and float16 brains: five layers, 10,256 weights in all.
